svg.aria-label: ICP from Won Deals workflow, top to bottom
svg.text: TRIGGER Closed-won and closed-lost deals from the last 12 to 24 months plus the best 10
OUTCOME A buildable ICP every list can be tested against
Every won deal in the window with value, cycle length,
close date and the first contact's title
Every lost deal in the window with the loss reason as
Won and lost in one file so the model sees both sides
The stack the company runs, since a
tool on the site often predicts the
open roles in the owning function
What the won deals share, ranked by how much more
often it appears in won than in lost
What the lost deals share that the won deals lack,
What was true at each of the 10 customers before they bought, not after
A revenue or headcount floor and
the function that owns the problem
One this-quarter trigger a list can
One message must fit every company in the segment or the segment splits
Each won and lost company scored against the written ICP without seeing its outcome
Share of closed-won that pass and share of closed-lost that fail; 95 percent and a clear cluster,
or the ICP goes back a step
Homepage and one product page per company, pulled
A cheap model reads the site and the ICP, returns a
score, a label and one reason
The ICP as prose and the same ICP as structured fields every other play reads
Last 90 days of won and lost rescored; the ICP moves only when the numbers do
A buildable ICP every list can be tested against
